summary: Faithful, well-verified implementation of D-52(A)/D-56/D-57. 14 of 15 spot-checks CONFIRMED against HEAD; the M4.3b absorption claim, the forward-pole residue, the make-target inventory, the 3.5 m/s walking model, and the H1 requirement are all true. One real defect: AC3's grep alternation is a literal pipe under -E, so that criterion passes vacuously (cheap fix). Physics gating via G-M4-S2/S3/S4 plus S1 renders is adequate and the G-M4-1 drop is justified. Sizing, deps, JSON and the Mark question are sound. Passes at 84; recommend approval after the grep fix, which can be applied as a small edit rather than a re-plan.
